Contrarius Investment Management LTD Increases Holding in Macys (M); Lemaitre Vascular (LMAT) Holder Aqr Capital Management Has Cut Position by $1.84 Million as Market Valuation Rose
April 29, 2018 - By Michael Collier
Cliff Asness decreased its stake in Lemaitre Vascular Inc (LMAT) by 27.76% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Aqr Capital Management Llc sold 59,306 shares as the company’s stock rose 13.61% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Cliff Asness held 154,318 shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $4.91 million, down from 213,624 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Aqr Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Lemaitre Vascular Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $607.17M market cap company. The stock decreased 2.67% or $0.86 during the last trading session, reaching $31.49. About 408,179 shares traded or 198.80% up from the average. LeMaitre Vascular, Inc. (NASDAQ:LMAT) has risen 48.54% since April 29, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 36.99% the S&P500.
Contrarius Investment Management Ltd increased its stake in Macys Inc (M) by 290.53% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Contrarius Investment Management Ltd bought 4.58 million shares as the company’s stock rose 8.53% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 6.15M shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $155.00 million, up from 1.58 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Contrarius Investment Management Ltd who had been investing in Macys Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $9.85 billion market cap company. The stock increased 1.39% or $0.44 during the last trading session, reaching $32.19. About 7.87M shares traded. Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) has declined 0.25% since April 29, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 11.80% the S&P500.
Contrarius Investment Management Ltd, which manages about $2.01B US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Arch Coal Inc by 533,475 shares to 96,478 shares, valued at $8.99 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in New York Times Co (NYSE:NYT) by 530,269 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 4.20 million shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
Among 31 analysts covering Macy’s Inc. ( NYSE:M ), 8 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 21 Hold. Therefore 26% are positive. Macy’s Inc. had 107 analyst reports since July 24, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. Barclays Capital maintained the shares of M in report on Wednesday, February 24 with “Underweight” rating. The stock of Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) has “Outperform” rating given on Thursday, March 1 by BMO Capital Markets. The stock of Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) earned “Neutral” rating by UBS on Friday, August 12. The rating was maintained by Deutsche Bank on Monday, August 17 with “Sell”. As per Friday, July 24, the company rating was downgraded by Atlantic Securities. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, September 28 by Cowen & Co. Jefferies maintained Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) rating on Friday, November 10. Jefferies has “Hold” rating and $20.0 target. Goldman Sachs downgraded Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) rating on Friday, December 4. Goldman Sachs has “Neutral” rating and $42 target. The stock of Macy's, Inc. (NYSE:M) earned “Neutral” rating by Credit Suisse on Friday, August 11. The rating was maintained by Macquarie Research with “Buy” on Saturday, August 15.
Among 12 analysts covering LeMaitre Vascular ( NASDAQ:LMAT ), 6 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 6 Hold. Therefore 50% are positive. LeMaitre Vascular had 39 analyst reports since July 29, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Neutral” rating given on Thursday, September 22 by Sidoti. The rating was downgraded by Benchmark on Friday, October 27 to “Hold”. Benchmark maintained LeMaitre Vascular, Inc. (NASDAQ:LMAT) rating on Wednesday, July 29. Benchmark has “Buy” rating and $14 target. The rating was downgraded by First Analysis to “Hold” on Friday, October 27. The rating was maintained by Canaccord Genuity with “Hold” on Monday, September 4. The firm earned “Mkt Perform” rating on Wednesday, February 22 by Barrington Research. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Monday, July 10 by Benchmark. The firm has “Hold” rating by Canaccord Genuity given on Thursday, July 27. The stock has “Outperform” rating by Barrington Research on Thursday, February 25. The firm has “Buy” rating by TH Capital given on Wednesday, July 29.
Aqr Capital Management Llc, which manages about $95.29B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Electronic Arts Inc (NASDAQ:EA) by 447,140 shares to 2.59M shares, valued at $272.19M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Magna Intl Inc (NYSE:MGA) by 378,881 shares in the quarter, for a total of 3.70M shares, and has risen its stake in Jabil Inc (NYSE:JBL). Michael Collier
